# FileColumnTransferHelper

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Migration.Import.FileColumnTransferHelper`

## Summary

Handles chunked upload/download of file column binary data. Uses 4MB (4,194,304 byte) chunks per Dataverse SDK limit.
